name: Codex Brain Token-Usage Payload Parity Fix
goal: Restore existing Commander heartbeat token accounting for Codex Brain by reading the cumulative breakdown in the installed app-server payload.

tasks.name: Normalize cumulative Codex token usage with protocol-shaped TDD
tasks.description: Preserve flat fallback coverage, add the installed nested payload, prove RED, select tokenUsage.total in the provider adapter, prove GREEN, and stage only the two bounded files.

steps.description: Keep the existing flat fallback test and add a schema-shaped event whose last and total values differ and whose explicit totalTokens is 191 rather than the derived sum 180.
Run the single protocol-shaped test and prove it fails because the current parser returns zero.
steps.expected: Exit 1 with assertion 0 == 110; after GREEN, the explicit 191 assertion also rejects a parser that always derives 180. Any other RED result stops execution.

steps.description: Update CodexBrainClient.get_token_usage to select dictionary-valued usage.total and otherwise retain flat parsing.
Run the focused Codex Brain client suite.
steps.expected: Exit 0; all Codex Brain client tests pass.

steps.description: Run notification tests to prove presentation behavior remains unchanged.
Stage only the two Task 1 source and test paths.
steps.expected: Exit 0; the two bounded Task 1 paths are staged.

steps.description: Enumerate staged paths and reject any unrelated source path.
steps.command: git -C /Users/roberthyatt/Code/ironclaude diff --cached --name-only | /usr/bin/python3 -c 'import sys; paths=[line.strip() for line in sys.stdin if line.strip()]; required={"commander/src/ironclaude/codex_brain_client.py","commander/tests/test_codex_brain_client.py"}; workflow={"docs/plans/2026-08-03-codex-brain-token-usage-payload-fix-design.md","docs/plans/2026-08-03-codex-brain-token-usage-payload-fix-requirements.md","docs/plans/2026-08-03-codex-brain-token-usage-payload-fix.md","docs/plans/2026-08-03-codex-brain-token-usage-payload-fix.plan.json"}; unexpected=set(paths)-(required|workflow); missing=required-set(paths); print("STAGED_PATHS"); print("\n".join(paths)); print("MISSING_TASK_PATHS="+("none" if not missing else ",".join(sorted(missing)))); print("UNEXPECTED_PATHS="+("none" if not unexpected else ",".join(sorted(unexpected)))); raise SystemExit(0 if not missing and not unexpected else 1)'
steps.expected: Exit 0 with all four workflow artifacts and both Task 1 paths listed, MISSING_TASK_PATHS=none, and UNEXPECTED_PATHS=none.

tasks.name: Run full verification and activate the repaired Commander
tasks.description: Make no file edits; run the full Commander suite, verify a single live runtime, use the existing SIGHUP restart path, and inspect bounded startup evidence.

steps.description: Run the full Commander test suite.
Enumerate pre-restart Commander and Codex app-server processes and require exactly one of each.
steps.command: ps -axo pid=,ppid=,command= | /usr/bin/python3 -c 'import sys; rows=[]; [rows.append((int(parts[0]),int(parts[1]),parts[2])) for line in sys.stdin for parts in [line.strip().split(None,2)] if len(parts)==3]; daemons=[row for row in rows if "/commander/.venv/bin/python -m ironclaude.main" in row[2] and "python3 -c" not in row[2]]; parents={pid:ppid for pid,ppid,_ in rows}; descends=lambda pid,ancestor: any(parent==ancestor for parent in iter(lambda p=[pid]: (p.__setitem__(0,parents.get(p[0],-1)) or p[0]),-1)); owned=[] if len(daemons)!=1 else [row for row in rows if row[2].startswith("codex app-server") and descends(row[0],daemons[0][0])]; print(f"COMMANDER_DAEMONS={len(daemons)}"); print(f"COMMANDER_OWNED_CODEX_APP_SERVERS={len(owned)}"); print("\n".join(str(row) for row in daemons+owned)); raise SystemExit(0 if len(daemons)==1 and len(owned)==1 else 1)'
steps.expected: Exit 0 with COMMANDER_DAEMONS=1 and COMMANDER_OWNED_CODEX_APP_SERVERS=1 plus enumerated owned processes.

steps.description: Send the existing Commander restart signal.
steps.expected: Exit 0 with Restart signal sent to daemon PID followed by the enumerated PID.
